title: Run the editorial example to 1,000+ cycles and record the learning curve
description: Run the prequential study on the extended corpus with review-everything feedback, same decision model and optimizer settings as the 400-cycle recording, and record per-100-cycle windows: accuracy, precision, recall, F1, Brier, calibration error, mean stated confidence, optimizer events, model calls, wall-clock time, and provider cost. Questions: where does accuracy plateau, how many corrections did it take, and what did the run cost. Acceptance: a recording directory plus an exported fixture (same schema as editorial-run-v1 with a schema bump) and a short results note with the curve.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Attempt 4 (fresh, gpt-4.1-mini, empty starting rubric, review-everything) stopped at cycle 1125 of 1200: a rubric step failed with sqlite3.OperationalError, most likely the store's 5-second lock timeout tripped by a read-only progress query against the live log (filed as decision-flywheel-189dddde). 1,124 cycles completed; cost $5.67 at list prices (decision model $2.74, optimizer $2.93), 148 minutes. Accuracy per 100 cycles: 57, 85, 84, 66, 82, 81, 84, 83, 83, 82, 79 (and 22 of the last 25). Rubric proposals: 24, all provisional, none promoted; the ML head was promoted at 200, 400, 600 and 800 and rejected once. The cyclotron's label differed from the decision model's on 38 cycles, all in 324 to 367 under one rubric version (cyclotron right 21, decision model 17), and nowhere else. No results.json was written, so no fixture yet. Data kept at ~/Documents/Codex/2026-10-09/editorial-study/run-1200-attempt4-db-locked-at-1125.
